after: in the north of the USA.
subject: I
explanation:
I used to live in the north of the USA.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to live exprime une habitude passée révolue : j'y vivais autrefois, mais plus maintenant.

after: the piano when she was younger.
subject: She
explanation:
She used to play the piano when she was younger.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to play décrit une habitude passée qui n'existe plus aujourd'hui.

after: a dog when I was a child.
subject: We
explanation:
We used to have a dog when I was a child.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to have décrit un état passé révolu. On peut utiliser used to avec des états aussi bien que des actions.

after: her bike to school every day.
subject: She
explanation:
She used to ride her bike to school every day.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Every day confirme qu'il s'agit d'une habitude passée régulière, parfaite pour used to.

after: summers at our grandparents' house.
subject: We
explanation:
We used to spend summers at our grandparents' house.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to spend évoque une habitude passée nostalgique — on le faisait chaque été autrefois.

after: to work every morning.
subject: He
explanation:
He used to walk to work every morning.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to walk décrit une routine passée qui a changé (il prend peut-être la voiture maintenant).

after: to the cinema every weekend.
subject: My parents
explanation:
My parents used to go to the cinema every weekend.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Every weekend souligne la régularité de l'habitude. Used to go est la forme correcte.

after: afraid of spiders when I was little.
subject: I
explanation:
I used to be afraid of spiders when I was little.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to be exprime un état passé révolu. Be s'utilise en base verbale après used to.

after: in a small village in the countryside.
subject: They
explanation:
They used to live in a small village in the countryside.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to live indique un état passé permanent qui a changé depuis.

after: a lot of comics when she was a teenager.
subject: She
explanation:
She used to read a lot of comics when she was a teenager.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
La précision temporelle when she was a teenager confirme qu'il s'agit d'une période passée révolue.

after: football every Saturday.
subject: He
explanation:
He used to play football every Saturday.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to play décrit une habitude sportive passée et régulière.

after: dinner together as a family every night.
subject: We
explanation:
We used to eat dinner together as a family every night.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to eat évoque une habitude familiale passée et régulière.

after: homemade bread every Sunday.
subject: My grandmother
explanation:
My grandmother used to make homemade bread every Sunday.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Every Sunday = chaque dimanche. Used to make décrit une habitude passée et régulière.

after: at 6 a.m. every day.
subject: I
explanation:
I used to wake up at 6 a.m. every day.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Wake up est un verbe à particule (phrasal verb). On le garde intact après used to.

after: of becoming a doctor.
subject: She
explanation:
She used to dream of becoming a doctor.
Phrase affirmative : sujet + used to + base verbale.
Used to dream décrit un rêve ou une aspiration passée qui a peut-être changé.

after: skiing.
subject: He
explanation:
He didn't use to go skiing.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
⚠️ À la forme négative, on écrit use to (sans d) car didn't porte déjà le passé.

after: spicy food.
subject: They
explanation:
They didn't use to like spicy food.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Didn't use to indique quelque chose qui n'était pas habituel dans le passé.

after: horror movies.
subject: My brother
correct: My brother didn't use to watch
explanation:
My brother didn't use to watch horror movies.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
⚠️ Avec didn't, on écrit toujours use to sans d final.

after: reading books.
subject: He
explanation:
He didn't use to enjoy reading books.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Enjoy + -ing : après enjoy, le verbe suivant prend toujours la forme -ing — mais ici enjoy est la base verbale après use to.

after: abroad.
subject: They
explanation:
They didn't use to travel abroad.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Abroad = à l'étranger. Rappel clé : avec didn't, jamais de -d sur use.

after: vegetables when she was a child.
subject: She
explanation:
She didn't use to eat vegetables when she was a child.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
La précision when she was a child ancre l'habitude dans le passé révolu.

after: coffee when I was a teenager.
subject: I
explanation:
I didn't use to like coffee when I was a teenager.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Indique que le goût a changé avec le temps — on peut ne pas aimer quelque chose puis l'apprécier plus tard.

after: much in class.
subject: He
explanation:
He didn't use to talk much in class.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Much = beaucoup. Didn't use to talk much décrit un comportement passé habituel (être silencieux).

after: a computer at home.
subject: We
explanation:
We didn't use to have a computer at home.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Used to s'utilise aussi pour parler d'un état passé (possession). Have = avoir/posséder.

after: a car when they were young.
subject: My parents
correct: My parents didn't use to own
explanation:
My parents didn't use to own a car when they were young.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Own = posséder. Used to fonctionne bien avec les verbes d'état comme own, have, be.

after: glasses when she was a child.
subject: She
explanation:
She didn't use to wear glasses when she was a child.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Wear = porter (un vêtement, des lunettes…). Verbe irrégulier au prétérit simple (wore), mais on utilise la base verbale après use to.

after: to bed so late when they were kids.
subject: They
explanation:
They didn't use to go to bed so late when they were kids.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Go to bed = aller au lit. Expression idiomatique très fréquente — la base verbale reste go.

after: how to swim.
subject: I
explanation:
I didn't use to know how to swim.
Phrase négative : sujet + didn't use to + base verbale.
Know how to = savoir (faire quelque chose). Know est ici la base verbale après use to.

after: in this city when you were a child?
explanation:
Did you use to live in this city…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
⚠️ À la forme interrogative, on commence par Did et on écrit use to (sans d).

after: to school when he was young?
explanation:
Did he use to walk to school…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Did porte le passé → le verbe reste à la base verbale : walk, pas walked.

after: sports when she was at school?
explanation:
Did she use to enjoy sports…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Enjoy reste à la base verbale après use to. On ne dit pas did she used to — c'est une erreur très fréquente !

after: a garden when they were children?
explanation:
Did they use to have a garden…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Used to peut porter sur un état (have a garden) aussi bien que sur une action habituelle.

after: vegetables when you were a child?
explanation:
Did you use to like vegetables…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Question classique sur un goût passé. Rappel : use to (pas used to) après Did.

after: video games when he was a teenager?
explanation:
Did he use to play video games…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
When he was a teenager ancre la question dans une période passée précise.

after: abroad when they were young?
answers: did your parents use to live
correct: Did your parents use to live
explanation:
Did your parents use to live abroad…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Abroad = à l'étranger. Le sujet peut être un groupe nominal comme your parents.

after: shy when she was a child?
explanation:
Did she use to be shy…?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Be s'utilise en base verbale, même dans les questions. Shy = timide.

after: on holiday every summer?
explanation:
Did they use to go on holiday every summer?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Go on holiday = partir en vacances. Every summer souligne le caractère habituel et répété.

after: early on school days?
answers: did you use to wake up
correct: Did you use to wake up
explanation:
Did you use to wake up early on school days?
Phrase interrogative : Did + sujet + use to + base verbale ?
Wake up est un verbe à particule. On garde les deux mots ensemble après use to.
